options: A URN names a resource without saying where it is; a URL says where it lives
A URN can only be used for books

02-html-and-css.q: A user sees www.apple.com with a valid padlock, but the real URL is https://www.xn--80ak6aa92e.com/. What attack is this?
02-html-and-css.explain: A Cyrillic 'а' looks identical to Latin 'a'. A valid TLS cert proves you reached that domain, not the one you think you read.

02-html-and-css.q: In a URI, what does # separate?

options: Server + client-side processing with asynchronous JavaScript calls

02-html-and-css.q: How do you write the < character in HTML content?

options: Radio: one choice; checkbox: many choices

02-html-and-css.q: Which way of attaching CSS is the "good" one?
02-html-and-css.explain: External: one file styles the whole site, it's cached, and designers can edit it without touching markup.

02-html-and-css.q: What does the selector E > F match?
options: Any F descendant of E at any depth
Any F that is a direct child of E

02-html-and-css.q: Rules: b {red} · b b {blue} · b.foo {green} · b b.foo {yellow}. What colour is <b class="foo"> nested inside another <b>?
02-html-and-css.explain: The most specific selector wins, not the last one written. b b.foo beats b.foo.

02-html-and-css.q: Why does so much invalid HTML exist on the web?
options: Forgiving browsers interpret invalid input rather than rejecting it (plus ignorance, lack of testing, tools)

02-html-and-css.q: How does HTML5 deal with invalid markup?
options: It standardizes the error handling, defining how broken markup is parsed

02-html-and-css.q: HIRAGANA LETTER SA is U+3055. What does U+3055 represent?
02-html-and-css.explain: Character → number is the code point. Number → picture is the glyph. Number → bytes is the encoding.

02-html-and-css.q: In UTF-8, a first byte starting with 1110 means…
Why is ASCII text automatically valid UTF-8?
options: Code points 0–127 coincide with ASCII and are encoded as a single byte 0XXXXXXX

02-html-and-css.q: Why does UTF-16 begin with a byte order mark?
options: Its code unit is 2 bytes, so the reader must know whether bytes are big- or little-endian

02-html-and-css.q: A page shows garbled characters (mojibake) even though the bytes are correct. What is the root cause?
options: The page's character encoding was interpreted incorrectly (wrong or missing charset declaration)

02-html-and-css.q: In Java, why is String.length() wrong for characters above 65,536?
options: Java strings count UTF-16 code units, and those characters need a surrogate pair (2 units)
It's a bug in the JVM

03-javascript.q: What does AJAX allow?
options: Asynchronous data requests from the browser so the page updates without a full reload

03-javascript.q: Which way of including JavaScript is best?

Why does 0.1 + 0.2 not exactly equal 0.3 in JavaScript?

03-javascript.q: Which way of declaring a function should be avoided because it causes many problems?
options: new Function(…) constructor with the body as a string

03-javascript.q: An arrow function does NOT have its own…
03-javascript.explain: Arrow functions have no own this, super, new.target or arguments.

03-javascript.q: A function passed into another function to be invoked later is a…

options: At design-time — lexically, by where code is written

03-javascript.q: console.log(myString) runs before var myString = 'Hello' in the same function. What is printed?
03-javascript.explain: The declaration is hoisted, not the initialization.

03-javascript.q: Calling a function expression stored in a var before its assignment line gives "calculateTax is not a function". Why?
options: Only the var declaration is hoisted; the assignment stays in place, so it's still undefined

03-javascript.q: What happens when you call a function with new?
options: A new empty object is created, bound as this, and returned (if no return statement)

03-javascript.q: setType(car, 'TVR') sets v.type inside the function. After the call, car.type is 'TVR'. Why?
options: Objects are passed by reference, so the original is modified

03-javascript.q: Why attach randomRoll to Die.prototype instead of defining it inside the constructor?

04-the-http-protocol.explain: HTTP is stateless — each request stands alone.

No caching → CDNs; no forms → JavaScript
